# awscc_networkflowmonitor_scope (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::NetworkFlowMonitor::Scope. Creates a scope to define the resources that Network Flow Monitor monitors for network performance.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `targets` (Attributes List) The targets for the scope. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--targets))

### Optional

- `tags` (Attributes List) The tags for the scope. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `scope_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the scope.
- `scope_id` (String) The identifier for the scope.
- `status` (String) The status of the scope.

Required:

- `region` (String) The AWS Region for the target resource.

<a id="nestedatt--targets--target_identifier"></a>
### Nested Schema for `targets.target_identifier`

- `target_type` (String) The type of the target. Currently always ACCOUNT.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_networkflowmonitor_scope.example
  identity = {
    scope_arn = "scope_arn"
  }
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:
